'''Sarell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the raging [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Sarell and his troops battled the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] in [[Gorinth Canyon]] until they were poisoned by toxic fumes. While the troops were being treated, he and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Betrin]] debated as to whether to destroy the toxin along with the fertile soil in process or spend time devising an antidote instead.<ref name="TOR" />
